name: Erie County Summer Youth Employment Program
what_you_do: Youth work at a job site 20 hours a week for eight weeks. They also must join learning activities.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 20. Where you are placed depends on your situation and your household income. Spots are limited and not promised.
pay_detail: Paid. The rate is not stated on the page.
duration: 8 weeks, 20 hours a week (2026: June 28 to Aug 28)
deadline_text: Application dates are not stated on the About page. The 2026 program ran June 28 to Aug 28. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the About page. Use the application and handbook links on the program's site. Depends on New York State funding.
notes: This is Erie County in New York (Buffalo), not Erie, Pennsylvania. Check the site for income limits.
